metadata.title: The reverse isoperimetric inequality for convex shapes included in a triangle
metadata.abstract: We establish a sharp reverse isoperimetric inequality for convex subsets of a triangle under a prescribed area constraint. Given a triangle $T$ and an area fraction $\eta\in(0,1)$, we determine the set with maximal perimeter among convex bodies $K\subset T$ satisfying $|K|=\eta|T|$ and characterize the equality cases. Every maximizer is a triangle, and the optimal configuration is obtained by retaining a longest side of $T$ and placing the third vertex on a shortest side, at the position determined by the area constraint. This characterization yields an explicit expression for the maximal perimeter in terms of $\eta$ and the side lengths of $T$.

analysis.workSummary: 固定三角形 T 和面积比例 η∈(0,1)，作者在 K⊂T、面积为 η|T| 的凸体中确定周长最大者并刻画等号。每个最大者仍是三角形：保留 T 的一条最长边，第三顶点置于一条最短边上由面积约束确定的位置，从而得到用 η 及边长表示的显式最大周长。
techniques: 平面凸几何的面积约束极值
analysis.breakthrough: 在固定容器和面积双重约束下给出完整最大周长构型，将反等周问题化为可显式计算的三角形配置。
analysis.limitations: 限定凸子集、三角形容器和严格介于零一的面积比例；不能外推到非凸子集或一般容器。多条最长或最短边时的等号对称情况应按正文区分。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

analysis.priorityReason: 是明确的尖锐凸几何结果，可作比较型极值问题参考，但非黎曼流核心方向。
